text.arabic_uthmani: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلْنَا لَهُۥ فِيهَا مَا نَشَآءُ لِمَن نُّرِيدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَىٰهَا مَذْمُومًۭا مَّدْحُورًۭا

words.gloss_range: conditional whoever opening; universal person-type rather than named actor
words.prose: {{ar:مَّن}} ({{tr:man}}) opens the ayah as an anonymous condition, so the sequence reads as a rule for whoever enters this desire-state rather than a story about one named person. Its conditional force can carry the answer through the whole chain, from limited hastening to final burning, while the boundary with 17:17 turns collective destruction into the inner mechanism of one desiring subject.

topics.headline: universal conditional frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah begins as an open conditional rule whose consequence can include the whole punishment chain.
topics.reason: The opening particle is syntactically conditional, and the clause structure allows the response to extend beyond the first hastening unit.

topics.headline: history narrowed to one desiring subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 17:18 personalizes the preceding warning by moving from known sins and destroyed generations into a single generic case.
topics.reason: The prior context in 17:17 supplies collective and evidentiary background, while this word introduces an impersonal individual condition.

words.gloss_range: auxiliary or existential perfect establishing a settled ongoing state
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, and occurring; here locally narrowed to auxiliary state-framing for sustained desire
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) makes the condition more than a flash of wanting. The perfect auxiliary with the following imperfect frames a settled or habitual state, and the singular form stages the universal rule through one person. Within Surah 17, the wording also resonates with the human hastiness statement in 17:11, so the desire for immediacy appears as a concrete case of that anthropology; the being-state set here becomes the premise for the later act of assignment.

topics.headline: settled ongoing desire-state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition targets an established orientation, not an isolated moment of wanting.
topics.reason: The verb governs the following imperfect as predicate, giving desire a sustained state-frame.

topics.headline: being-state answered by outcome-making
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the inward state set here as the premise that later becomes a divinely assigned outcome.
topics.reason: Same-surah and co-occurrence evidence connect the being-state with human hastiness and the later making verb without overriding the local auxiliary function.

words.gloss_range: imperfect Form IV desire directed toward the immediate object
words.root_gloss_range: seeking, moving toward, and intending; here the Form IV will-sense is locally selected

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby referenced word in this ayah
nearby referenced word in this ayah

words.prose: {{ar:يُرِيدُ}} ({{tr:yurīdu}}) keeps the human desire in progress inside the state-frame of {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}). The Form IV verb points the will toward its object, so the immediate is not an accidental attraction but the chosen target. Its sound and root return in {{ar:نُّرِيدُ}} ({{tr:nurīdu}}), where the human singular desire is enclosed by divine intention, and 17:19 sharpens the contrast with willing the Hereafter.

topics.headline: imperfect desire inside the state frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that desire is the continuing content of the condition rather than an independent present-tense assertion.
topics.reason: The imperfect is governed inside the preceding state verb and takes the following object, preserving ongoing orientation.

topics.headline: desire as directed movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees desire as purposive movement toward the immediate object, not as a passive feeling.
topics.reason: The root field and Form IV morphology support a directed will-sense, while the explicit object fixes the local target.

topics.headline: human desire answered by divine intention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same desire-form return under a different subject, shifting control from the human desirer to divine selection.
topics.reason: The later matching verb has the same root and form but a divine plural subject, and 17:19 provides a same-surah contrast in the desire field.

words.gloss_range: the definite immediate; active participle used as substantive and direct object
words.root_gloss_range: haste, speed, and immediacy; locally the substantive temporal object desired by the subject

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby referenced word in this ayah

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ}} ({{tr:al-ʿājilata}}) names the object of desire as the definite immediate, not merely wanting quickly. As the immediate side of an immediate/deferred polarity, it prepares the delayed turn that follows later in the ayah. Its feminine active-participle shape makes immediacy feel like a rushing reality chosen as a target. The same root then comes back in {{ar:عَجَّلْنَا}} ({{tr:ʿajjalnā}}), so the desired haste rebounds as divine acceleration, while the few parallel uses in 75:20 and 76:27 keep the orientation morally marked.

topics.headline: definite substantive object of desire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah identifies a specific temporal object of desire rather than condemning desire in the abstract.
topics.reason: Case and attachment evidence make the word the object of the desire verb, and its definite substantive form gives the target a recognized profile.

topics.headline: immediate side of the temporal polarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the desired object as a known temporal orientation opposed to the deferred end, not a neutral present benefit.
topics.reason: The active-participle substantive is rare and occurs in blameworthy desire or love contexts such as 75:20 and 76:27.

topics.headline: desired haste mirrored by divine hastening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what the person wants returns in the very verb of divine response.
topics.reason: The shared root between the object and the following divine verb creates a local lexical rebound.

words.gloss_range: Form II perfect divine acceleration beginning the apodosis
words.root_gloss_range: hastening and acceleration; locally intensified causative hastening under divine agency

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby referenced word in this ayah

words.prose: {{ar:عَجَّلْنَا}} ({{tr:ʿajjalnā}}) is the first divine perfect after the condition, shifting agency from the human desirer to divine response. Its Form II shape makes the response active acceleration, and its valency routes both a recipient and an open object into the act, so the desirer does not control either the mechanics or the content. Because it repeats the root of {{ar:ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ}} ({{tr:al-ʿājilata}}), the desired immediate becomes the intensified divine action at the structural turn of the ayah.

topics.headline: first divine perfect response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah pivot from human orientation into decisive divine agency.
topics.reason: The verb begins the conditional apodosis as a perfect divine plural form and aligns with the later perfect assignment verb.

topics.headline: recipient and content under acceleration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the immediate grant is targeted but not controlled by the desirer.
topics.reason: The verb governs a recipient phrase and an open relative object, making the hastened content and beneficiary syntactically constrained.

topics.headline: desired immediacy intensified as divine action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the desired immediate rebound as an intensified divine hastening rather than as self-directed success.
topics.reason: Form II morphology, the shared root with the previous object, and the apodosis position converge to make the acceleration both lexical and structural.

words.gloss_range: for him; first dative recipient phrase tied to the desiring subject
words.prose: The first {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahū}}) ties the hastened share back to the same singular person introduced by the opening condition. Its for-him grammar looks benefactive, but the later reprise before Hell makes that benefit ironic. The repeated recipient frame means the temporary grant and the final assignment belong to the same continuous chain.

topics.headline: same person receives the hastened share
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the desirer as the recipient of the hastened allotment rather than losing him in the divine action.
topics.reason: The masculine suffix resolves to the opening conditional subject and is governed as recipient of the hastening verb.

topics.headline: benefactive grammar under later reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar of receiving begins as for-him but is already moving toward loss.
topics.reason: The same phrase recurs later with Hell assignment, making the first recipient phrase part of an escalating pattern.

words.gloss_range: within it; locative phrase referring back to the immediate realm
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) confines the hastening inside the immediate realm named just before it. The feminine suffix points back to that object, while the preposition turns the immediate into a bounded arena in which the grant is dispensed. Because it comes before the open content clause, the ayah limits the sphere before it names whatever is willed. That localizes the prior divine knowledge of 17:17 into selective worldly allocation, not automatic reward.

topics.headline: the immediate as the container of the grant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grant remains inside the immediate domain and does not escape its limits.
topics.reason: The feminine suffix returns to the immediate object, and the locative preposition makes that object the sphere of hastening.

topics.headline: prior divine knowledge localized into allocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the worldly allocation as selective and known, not as an automatic reward for wanting.
topics.reason: The prior context of divine knowledge supports the local restriction without creating a new grammatical role.

words.gloss_range: whatever; open relative object whose content is determined by divine willing

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby referenced word in this ayah

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) keeps the hastened content open: the desirer wants the immediate, but the ayah does not hand him a named prize. As a relative object before {{ar:نَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:nashāʾu}}), it is recoverable as what is hastened and what is willed. It also starts the double restriction: what is given and for whom it is given are both held inside divine selection.

topics.headline: unspecified content under divine will
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the content of the worldly grant stays unspecified and therefore outside the desirer’s control.
topics.reason: The particle resolves as a relative object governed inside the divine willing clause and as the object field of hastening.

topics.headline: what and whom restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first limit in a paired structure that restricts both content and recipient.
topics.reason: The relative object is followed by a recipient-relative phrase, creating two linked constraints in the first response.

words.gloss_range: We will; imperfect divine willing that determines the content
words.root_gloss_range: willing and thingness; locally the divine will that specifies what is hastened

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby referenced word in this ayah

words.prose: {{ar:نَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:nashāʾu}}) closes the open content with divine willing. Its imperfect form keeps that determination active, and the plural prefix makes the subject visible inside the verb. Locally this will-verb selects what is hastened, while {{ar:نُّرِيدُ}} ({{tr:nurīdu}}) selects for whom; the variant with singular agency changes presentation of divine agency, not the fact that the content remains divinely willed.

topics.headline: ongoing divine will over content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unspecified thing is defined by divine will rather than by human demand.
topics.reason: The imperfect divine verb governs the open relative object and carries first-person plural agency in its prefix.

topics.headline: content will paired with recipient intention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees two adjacent will-verbs divide the field: one limits the what, the other limits the whom.
topics.reason: The local sequence pairs this verb with the following intention verb, and the row evidence distinguishes their contextual jobs.

topics.headline: plural and singular agency presentation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted recitational contrast exposes agency presentation while the standard wording keeps the first-person plural voice.
topics.reason: The variant shifts the prefix from first plural to third singular, but it does not replace the standard local form or alter the governing fact of divine willing.

words.gloss_range: for whom; prepositional relative phrase restricting recipient selection

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby referenced word in this ayah

words.prose: {{ar:لِمَنْ}} ({{tr:liman}}) turns the second occurrence of the whoever-form into a relative recipient phrase, not a new condition. It narrows the hastened grant to the one whom divine intention selects, and its attachment can qualify either the act of hastening or the granted content without removing the restriction. The repetition with the opening {{ar:مَّن}} ({{tr:man}}) brackets human desire with divine selection, and the repeated whoever-form makes that return audible as well as structural.

topics.headline: recipient restricted by the relative phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that not every desirer receives; the recipient is a divinely selected subset.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the relative pronoun and the following verb completes the selected recipient phrase.

topics.headline: attachment ambiguity still reinforces restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the syntax as layered selectivity rather than uncertainty that weakens the point.
topics.reason: Whether the phrase attaches to the hastening verb or to the open object, it blocks the reading that human desire mechanically controls receipt.

topics.headline: opening and inner whoever frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah return from the human whoever to the divinely selected whom.
topics.reason: The repeated surface form changes function from conditional to relative, and the sound binds the recipient phrase to the following divine verb.

words.gloss_range: We intend; divine Form IV intention closing the recipient restriction
words.root_gloss_range: seeking and intending; locally divine intention determining recipient scope

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby referenced word in this ayah

words.prose: {{ar:نُّرِيدُ}} ({{tr:nurīdu}}) closes the recipient restriction with divine intention. The same Form IV pattern heard earlier in {{ar:يُرِيدُ}} ({{tr:yurīdu}}) returns under a different subject, so the smallest prefix shift carries a major agency reversal. The discourse moves from he desires, through repeated We-actions, back to he burns; this word is the point where human wanting is explicitly outranked by divine selection.

topics.headline: divine intention selects the recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recipient class remains tied to active divine intention rather than to an independently named group.
topics.reason: The imperfect divine verb completes the relative phrase and carries the first-person plural subject in its prefix.

topics.headline: same desire-form under divine agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the earlier human desire-form return as divine intention that controls the outcome.
topics.reason: The two verbs share root and form, while the prefix and subject change from human singular to divine plural.

topics.headline: from singular desire to plural agency to singular consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks how the individual desirer passes through divine agency before returning as the individual subject of punishment.
topics.reason: The discourse profile traces a person-number arc across the ayah, and this verb completes the divine-agency middle segment.

words.gloss_range: then; delayed sequence marker introducing the second consequence unit
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) prevents the worldly hastening from looking like the final outcome. It creates an ordered interval: first a limited grant, then a complete second consequence in which Hell is assigned and the burning state unfolds. The heavy hinge also separates the two divine perfect verbs, making acceleration and assignment parallel but not simultaneous.

topics.headline: delayed transition to final consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the gap between temporary worldly receipt and later eschatological assignment.
topics.reason: The conjunction marks sequence with separation, dividing the first response from the later punishment unit.

topics.headline: scope over the whole second unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the particle governing not only the next verb but the whole final-state complex that follows.
topics.reason: Scope evidence extends the sequence marker through assignment, Hell, and the burning-state closure.

words.gloss_range: We assigned; perfect divine act designating Hell as final portion
words.root_gloss_range: making, rendering, placing, and assigning; here designation is locally selected

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby referenced word in this ayah

words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلْنَا}} ({{tr:jaʿalnā}}) is the second divine perfect, but its work differs from acceleration. With the recipient phrase and Hell as object, it designates a final portion rather than merely describing location or creation. Its near-echo with {{ar:عَجَّلْنَا}} ({{tr:ʿajjalnā}}) binds the two divine acts while the sequence escalates from measured worldly grant to eschatological assignment, and 17:8 supplies a same-surah assignment pattern.

topics.headline: Hell assigned as portion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb performs assignment: Hell becomes the person’s designated portion.
topics.reason: The argument structure combines a recipient phrase with Hell as object, selecting the designative branch of the making verb.

topics.headline: assignment pattern within Surah 17
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the local assignment as part of a Surah 17 punishment construction also visible in 17:8.
topics.reason: Same-surah rows link the making verb with Hell in 17:8 and with shame-outcome vocabulary locally.

topics.headline: paired divine acts with escalation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears two close divine verbs as a linked escalation from partial grant to total consequence.
topics.reason: The two perfect divine verbs share speaker marking and near sound while preserving different lexical jobs.

words.gloss_range: for him; second dative recipient phrase assigning Hell to the same person
words.prose: The second {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahū}}) returns the same singular recipient after the delayed hinge. The first for-him phrase received the hastened share; this one receives Hell as the assigned portion. That repetition turns benefactive grammar inside out and prevents the reader from separating the temporary grant from the final punishment.

topics.headline: same recipient receives Hell assignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same person from worldly receipt into final assignment.
topics.reason: The suffix repeats the earlier recipient form and is governed by the assignment verb rather than the hastening verb.

topics.headline: for-him grammar inverted by punishment object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the grammar of assignment uses a for-him form when the assigned object is punishment.
topics.reason: The recipient construction is locally governed by a punishment object, reversing the ordinary benefactive feel of the phrase.

words.gloss_range: Hell; proper named place assigned as object and resumed by the burning suffix
words.root_gloss_range: proper named eschatological destination; depth imagery remains secondary and qualifying

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby referenced word in this ayah

words.prose: {{ar:جَهَنَّمَ}} ({{tr:jahannama}}) is the object assigned by {{ar:جَعَلْنَا}} ({{tr:jaʿalnā}}), not a background location. Its proper-name and diptote profile make the destination determinate, while the place-origin and depth associations make the assigned end feel enclosing without replacing the proper-name sense. Surah 17 returns to this named destination in 17:8 and 17:39, and the 17:39 pairing with expulsion makes this word part of a repeated condemnation thread. The doubled center of the name also makes the assigned object feel weight-bearing.

topics.headline: proper destination as assigned object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the named destination as the determinate object assigned to the person, not merely as scene-setting.
topics.reason: Case role, proper-name status, and diptote behavior all support the word as the assigned object.

topics.headline: place-origin and depth pressure under proper-name sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the assigned proper destination as spatially enclosing and downward, while the local sense remains the named eschatological place.
topics.reason: The supplied etymological and place-origin evidence can color the destination, but the grammar and proper noun evidence keep the proper-name sense primary.

topics.headline: Surah 17 Hell condemnation thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this assignment belongs to a same-surah punishment thread that returns strongly at 17:39.
topics.reason: Same-surah rows connect this word with 17:8 and 17:39 and with the final expulsion vocabulary.

topics.headline: heavy proper-name sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the proper name carry weight at the center of the second consequence.
topics.reason: The phonetic row ties the internal doubling of the name to its role as the weight-bearing assigned object.

words.gloss_range: he burns in it; imperfect circumstantial fire-exposure with Hell as direct suffix object
words.root_gloss_range: burning, roasting, exposure to fire, and a broader prayer-adjacent root field; here physical fire exposure is primary
words.prose: {{ar:يَصْلَىٰهَا}} ({{tr:yaṣlāhā}}) makes the assignment immediately experiential: Hell is not only for him, it is the direct object of his burning exposure through the feminine suffix. As an imperfect circumstantial clause after the assignment verb, it describes his ongoing state. The broader root field creates a same-surah tension with prayer contexts in 17:78 and 17:110, but the local object makes physical fire-exposure primary; the Form II variant clarifies agency contrast without replacing the standard Form I state. Its long vowel lets the burning exposure linger before the closing states arrive.

topics.headline: Hell as direct object of burning state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Hell is not merely assigned; the person is shown undergoing object-bound burning in it.
topics.reason: The feminine suffix resumes Hell as direct object, and the imperfect clause functions circumstantially after the assignment verb.

topics.headline: physical fire-exposure within broader root tension
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a marked fire-use of a root field that elsewhere in Surah 17 is associated with prayer, while the local sense remains concrete burning.
topics.reason: The Hell object selects the physical burning sense; the prayer-field rows survive as same-surah semantic tension, not as a replacement sense.

topics.headline: standard state versus causative variant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard wording foregrounds the subject’s burning state, while the variant highlights caused entry into that burning.
topics.reason: The variant is valid contrast evidence for agency profile, but the standard Form I remains the local surface and controls the prose.

topics.headline: lengthened sound before the closing states
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the burning exposure extended before the final participles close the ayah.
topics.reason: The phonetic row ties the long vowel to the sustained exposure immediately before the double state closure.

words.gloss_range: blamed; first accusative passive participle describing the burning subject
words.root_gloss_range: blame, loss of praiseworthiness, and loss of protective standing; locally a moral state accompanying burning

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby referenced word in this ayah

words.prose: {{ar:مَذْمُومًۭا}} ({{tr:madhmūman}}) is not a label for Hell; its masculine singular form agrees with the human subject who burns. As an accusative circumstantial passive participle, it says he burns while blame falls on him. The word adds moral evaluation to physical punishment, including loss of protective standing and praiseworthiness, and its pairing with {{ar:مَّدْحُورًۭا}} ({{tr:madḥūran}}) binds blame to expulsion in a closing cadence also anticipated by warning pairs such as 17:22.

topics.headline: blame as circumstantial state of the burning person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees blame attached to the burning person as his state, not to Hell and not as a separate later verdict.
topics.reason: Agreement, accusative state function, passive participle form, and indefiniteness all attach the blame-state to the human subject.

topics.headline: moral blame and loss of standing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final punishment includes moral disgrace, not only bodily fire.
topics.reason: The supplied root field carries blame, contrast with praise, and loss of protective standing; local grammar makes that a state of the burning subject.

topics.headline: blame paired with expulsion in the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears blame and expulsion as a bound two-part closure rather than as isolated descriptors.
topics.reason: Same-surah recurrence at 17:22 and the matching participle shape with the next word make this a warning-pair closure.

words.gloss_range: expelled; second accusative passive participle closing the ayah with contemptuous exclusion
words.root_gloss_range: forceful repulsion, banishment, and contempt; locally an endured expulsion-state accompanying burning
words.prose: {{ar:مَّدْحُورًۭا}} ({{tr:madḥūran}}) lands as the final word, so expulsion is the ayah’s last semantic and auditory impression. It is a second circumstantial passive participle agreeing with the same burning subject, and its root field makes the exclusion forceful and contemptuous rather than neutral removal. The word links the hastener to the expulsion register of 7:18 and anchors the near-identical condemnation close of 17:39, where blame language changes but expulsion remains.

topics.headline: second circumstantial state on the same subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees expulsion as an endured state accompanying burning, parallel to blame and attached to the same person.
topics.reason: Case, agreement, passive participle form, and indefiniteness make the word a second state of the burning human subject.

topics.headline: forceful contemptuous expulsion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final state is active rejection and contemptuous driving away, not mere absence from mercy.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports forceful repulsion and banishment with contempt, and the local passive participle encodes endured exclusion.

topics.headline: expulsion echo across decisive condemnation scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the worldly hastener placed in an extreme expulsion register shared with 7:18 and repeated in the 17:39 condemnation close.
topics.reason: The row evidence links the word to the 7:18 expulsion scene and to the near-identical 17:39 close where expulsion remains constant.

topics.headline: final cadence seals blame and expulsion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the ending as one final-state complex: fire exposure, moral blame, spatial expulsion, and matching sound converge.
topics.reason: The final position, sound-pairing with the previous participle, boundary context from 17:17, and synthetic row all make the close more than a list of labels.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled desire root at words 3 and 11, the noun-verb repetition at words 4-5, the two selective clauses, and the then-sequence into Hell.
baseline_models.mechanism: A human will selects immediacy, but it does not control either content or recipient. A second will selects a thing and a person, accelerates only that intersection inside the immediate field, and then transforms the recipient's condition into exposure to fire, blame, and expulsion.

activation_trace.role: Desire and will supply the two agencies whose apparent lexical sameness masks an asymmetry of control.
Acceleration and presentation before due time supply the temporal operation applied to the desired field.
Will attached to a thing makes the accelerated content chosen rather than coextensive with the seeker's request.
Making as transformation carries the sequence from a granted condition into an assigned terminal condition.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the direct bodily consequence of the transformed condition.
The second mapped inventory independently preserves encountering fire as the consequence, preventing a merely figurative reading.
Blame and fault supply the evaluative exposure accompanying the bodily consequence.
Driving away supplies the final spatial and relational exclusion.

changed_reading.before: Whoever wants worldly life receives it and is later punished.
changed_reading.after: Whoever makes immediacy the object of desire enters a selective acceleration regime: only a divinely chosen content reaches a divinely chosen recipient, and the same sequence ends by assigning that recipient fire, exposed fault, and exclusion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of desire surround the accelerated object and divine choosing, while the acceleration root also carries a short-road image.
baseline_models.mechanism: The seeker is not only choosing a temporal domain but repeatedly scouting for a quick route through it. Desire can oscillate, search, and return, while the answer is governed by another will; the ayah therefore diagnoses a restless acquisition posture rather than a single settled preference.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and scouting supply an acquisitive search pattern inside the repeated desire construction.
Coming and going without settlement supplies the instability of that search.
The non-dominant mapped root contributes repetition, hesitation, and return, intensifying the doubled will as a feedback loop.
The quick or shortened road gives the restless search a shortcut logic.

changed_reading.before: The subject calmly prefers the present over the future.
changed_reading.after: The subject repeatedly scouts the present for a shortcut and remains unsettled inside desire; the second will in the ayah interrupts any assumption that this search governs its own result.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final pair, blamed and driven away, follows an imposed change of condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The blame root can carry covenant, guarantee, protected right, and inviolability as well as censure. Coupled with expulsion, the ending can register not only negative speech but the collapse of protected standing: the recipient is made exposed and then removed.

activation_trace.role: Transformation supplies the shift from apparent beneficiary status to an imposed unprotected status.
Covenant, guarantee, protected right, and scruple about violating them supply the social-juridical underside of being blamed.
Expulsion turns lost standing into actual removal from proximity and protection.

changed_reading.before: The ending adds two synonymous insults after punishment.
changed_reading.after: The ending layers censure with a loss of protected standing: fault is exposed, covenantal shelter is absent, and exclusion is enacted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier good-to-self and evil-against-self polarity turns the focus ayah's repeated 'for him' into a feedback marker. The accelerated object and Hell are not disconnected allotments; both are placed on the same recipient-facing circuit.

activation_trace.role: Doing good supplies the positive action whose benefit returns to the acting selves.
The self as the very same entity supplies the recipient to whom action returns.
What harms supplies the negative action that returns against that same self.
Transformation links the second 'for him' to the recipient's resulting condition.
Fault and blame disclose the negative value of what has returned to the seeker.

structural_cues: 17:7 states that good is for the selves and evil is against them; 17:18 uses 'for him' both for acceleration and for the making of Hell.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the self-return polarity and the doubled 'for him'; I infer that the repetition marks one consequence circuit. It may alternatively remain distributive grammar without saying that the grant itself contributes to the end.

changed_reading.before: A desired benefit is granted first, and an unrelated punishment is appended later.
changed_reading.after: The desired acceleration and the terminal allotment face the same self; the repeated 'for him' makes the apparent benefit part of a self-returning consequence pattern.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human who calls for harm with the same call used for benefit and is then named hasty supplies an epistemic defect behind the focus desire. Immediate wanting can mistake a harmful object for a good one, so selective divine willing is not merely restriction of quantity but a counter-agency against the seeker's unstable valuation.

activation_trace.role: Invocation of an unwelcome descent supplies the paradox of actively requesting what harms.
Harm and evil supply the misclassified requested object.
Inclination toward what benefits supplies the template with which the harmful request is confused.
Human haste explicitly diagnoses the temporal pressure under which harmful and beneficial objects are conflated.
The opposed occurrences of willing let divine selection interrupt the human valuation.
The focus noun-verb repetition converts the general human haste into the specific desired and administered acceleration.

structural_cues: 17:11 puts harm and benefit into the same prayer frame and closes with human haste; 17:18 opens with desire for the immediate and then limits both what and whom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hasty caller who treats harm like benefit; I infer that the immediate seeker may likewise misvalue the requested object. A deliberate preference for short-term benefit remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The seeker knowingly chooses a lesser temporal good.
changed_reading.after: The seeker may be unable, under haste, to distinguish benefit from harm; the selective clauses expose a conflict not only of timelines but of valuations.

context_deltas.mechanism: An attached record is brought out, opened, read by its own bearer, and made sufficient for reckoning while burden remains non-transferable. This gives the focus blame an evidentiary mechanism: it is a self-verifying assessment attached to the same person, not an arbitrary insult.

activation_trace.role: Binding and attaching by judgment supply the record's non-detachable relation to its bearer.
Written composition supplies the durable evidence that can be presented.
The opened or published writing supplies evidentiary disclosure.
Reading and recitation make the bearer participate in disclosure of the record.
The self as the identical entity supplies the witness-accountant who cannot be displaced.
Counting and reckoning supply the evaluative procedure behind the later blame.
A heavy burden supplies non-transferable personal consequence.
Blame and fault become the verdict made legible by the attached accounting sequence.

structural_cues: 17:13-15 proceeds from attachment at the neck to an opened book, self-reading, sufficient self-accounting, and non-transferable burden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an evidentiary sequence immediately before the focus; I infer that 'blamed' names its disclosed assessment. Blame could still denote social or divine censure without invoking the record mechanism directly.

changed_reading.before: Blame is a separate humiliating label added to fire.
changed_reading.after: Blame is the inspectable verdict of a record attached to, opened before, and read by the same recipient whose burden cannot be transferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent town sequence places divine will, affluent release, outward rupture, a consequence becoming due, and destruction on one chain. It activates the possibility that an accelerated present allotment is not a reward later cancelled but an enabling exposure through which a recipient's trajectory exits its covering and becomes due for judgment.

activation_trace.role: Divine willing initiates the adjacent destruction sequence and echoes the selecting will in the focus.
Expansive ease that releases its possessor supplies abundance as an enabling condition rather than a verdict of approval.
A ripe date exiting its covering supplies the material image of an inward trajectory becoming outwardly manifest.
A fixed due claim supplies the transition from manifested conduct to unavoidable consequence.
Extirpating destruction supplies the endpoint of the adjacent causal sequence.
Sin and culpability prevent the historical destruction sequence from reading as blind material collapse.
Knowledge of the report and inward reality supplies discriminating awareness behind the sequence.
Acceleration supplies the focus operation that can function as exposure rather than uncomplicated favor.

structural_cues: 17:16 orders will, a town, its affluent people, their rupture, the consequence becoming due, and destruction; 17:17 adds informed awareness of servants' sins before 17:18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered town sequence; I infer an analogy in which accelerated allotment can enable disclosure and consequence. The alternative is that 17:16 and 17:18 are parallel judgments with no claim that the focus grant helps produce the end.

changed_reading.before: Present granting is a genuine reward that is simply followed by a separate penalty.
changed_reading.after: Present acceleration can itself be probationary exposure: released abundance lets a trajectory emerge, become due, and terminate in the condition assigned by the focus ayah.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate-directed desire is paired with a later-directed desire that must be embodied in fitting movement and faith. Both groups nevertheless receive connected extension from an unrestricted gift, while the later field has larger graded differentiation. Present receipt therefore cannot by itself certify approval, and later-directed desire is not bare postponement but desire matched by sustained action.

activation_trace.role: Desire and intention repeat the focus agency while changing its object to the later field.
Deferral to a later time supplies the explicit temporal counter-object to immediacy.
Purposeful movement toward an object makes later-directed desire an enacted trajectory rather than a wish.
Recognition of gift supplies acknowledgment of the effort rather than mere possession of its object.
Connected increase that supports another supplies ongoing extension to both groups.
Giving and handing over supply the common source of what both groups presently receive.
Absence of prohibition prevents present gift from being restricted to the approved trajectory.
Degree and distinction supply comparison within both present and later fields.
Stepwise gradation supplies a scale larger than the binary possession or deprivation imagined by haste.
Acceleration supplies the near-term operation now relativized by common extension and larger later grades.

structural_cues: 17:18 and 17:19 are parallel desire constructions, but 17:19 adds effort proportioned to its object and faith; 17:20 extends both groups; 17:21 compares present distinctions with greater later grades.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the parallel pair, matched effort, common extension, and larger later grades; I infer that present receipt is not an approval signal. The exact scope and shape of the two groups' present extension remain unspecified.

changed_reading.before: One group gets the present while the other forgoes it in exchange for the future.
changed_reading.after: Both trajectories can receive present extension; their difference lies in what organizes desire, whether desire becomes fitting effort and trust, and the greater graded field in which that effort is acknowledged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening prohibition against delegating protection to another and the closing prohibition against making another deity frame a failed dependency mechanism. Making a surrogate object of reliance ends in blamed immobility and isolation; this activates the focus ending as the collapse of borrowed protection, not only penal relocation.

activation_trace.role: Handing one's affair to another supplies the delegated-dependence mechanism prohibited near the opening.
Making something into a status supplies the act that installs a surrogate object of allegiance.
Worship and the worshipped object specify the surrogate relation.
Being made unable to rise supplies the failed agency produced by that relation.
The repeated blame root contributes failed protection and violated standing at the frame's close.
Separation from one's group supplies abandonment and isolation as the result of surrogate reliance.
The focus blame receives the same protected-standing nuance activated by the repeated wording in 17:22.
Expulsion realizes the isolation latent in abandonment.

structural_cues: 17:2 prohibits taking a guardian besides God; 17:22 prohibits making another deity and ends with the same 'blamed' as 17:18 followed by abandonment rather than expulsion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the framing prohibitions and repeated blame formula; I infer that misplaced delegation explains loss of protection in the focus. The immediate seeker is not explicitly called an idolater, so this is a relational analogy rather than an identity claim.

changed_reading.before: The focus subject is expelled solely because of temporal preference.
changed_reading.after: The ending can also diagnose failed dependency: treating an immediate object as organizing reliance leaves the seeker without protected standing and finally isolated.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it spatializes a normally temporal contrast. It remains anchored in the focus acceleration root's explicit short-road branch and in the packet's night journey to the farthest boundary for disclosed signs. Downstream prose should present it as a route analogy, not replace 'the immediate' with 'the short road.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The noun-verb pair from the acceleration root at words 4-5, especially its quick-road or shortcut branch.

activation_trace.role: Night travel supplies a guided movement whose value is not immediate visibility.
Distance and the farthest boundary supply the route opposed to shortcut logic.
Showing and making visible supply the disclosure reached through the far journey.
The non-dominant mapped branch contributes deliberation, opposing reflexive shortcut selection.
A manifest sign supplies what the longer guided route is ordered to disclose.
The quick or shortened road supplies the focus-side route image.

changed_reading.before: The ayah contrasts only present time with later time.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary spatial image, it contrasts shortcut acquisition with a guided journey willing to cross darkness and distance in order to receive signs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the trap branches of the burning root are form-distant from the direct fire sense. It remains valid as a spatial overlay because 17:8 explicitly makes Hell an enclosing or confining place. Downstream prose must retain literal encounter with fire and qualify trap as the geometry of that encounter, not an alternative translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb of encountering Hell at word 16, whose split inventories preserve both direct fire and set-trap branches.

activation_trace.role: Confinement, prevention, and enclosure supply the spatial character of Hell in the nearby occurrence.
Making into a condition supplies the exact nearby construction that links Hell with enclosure.
Encountering fire preserves the direct surface consequence.
The second mapped inventory independently confirms fire and heat as primary.
Set snares and traps supply the secondary capture geometry.
The non-dominant mapped inventory also preserves the set-trap image, supporting rather than replacing the direct fire sense.

changed_reading.before: The subject reaches a place where fire inflicts pain.
changed_reading.after: The subject encounters fire inside a condition whose nearby and branch-activated geometry is enclosure: the accelerated route terminates not only in heat but in capture without an exit.

strongest_changes: The doubled 'for him' becomes a self-return circuit when read through 17:7, joining accelerated allotment and terminal allotment rather than leaving them as unrelated stages.
17:11 recasts immediate desire as hasty misclassification of harm as benefit, making divine selection a counter-agency to unstable human valuation.
17:13-15 gives 'blamed' an attached, self-read, non-transferable evidentiary mechanism.
17:16-17 permits accelerated abundance to function as exposure rather than uncomplicated favor.
17:19-21 shows that both trajectories receive present extension while later-directed desire is distinguished by fitting effort, trust, acknowledgment, and larger grades.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah is built from doubled will, doubled acceleration, repeated recipient marking, and a then-sequence from selected provision to transformed status. The context repeatedly converts those compact doublings into mechanisms of self-return, misvaluation, disclosure, exposure, differentiated effort, and failed protection without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The affluence sequence in 17:16 may be a causal analogue for accelerated provision or only an adjacent parallel judgment.
The covenantal nuance of the blame root and the trap nuance of the fire root are branch-backed but should remain qualified overlays.
The packet does not resolve whether the selective clauses primarily describe withholding, differential pacing, differential recipients, or all three.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The hurried object narrows both timing and recipient.** `ر و د:B001/B003` is intention and seeking; doubled `ع ج ل:B001` accelerates; `ش ي ء:B001/B002` links the knowable thing with willing; `د ح ر:B001` drives away. The seeker wants “the hurried,” but the response is limited by what is willed and for whom, then turns into expulsion. I infer desire for immediacy mistakes acceleration for control. The ayah reads the immediate world as selectively released provision that can culminate in exclusion, not as proof that desire governs outcome.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:74–75 makes “a little” inclination carry doubled consequence, correcting any equation of small quantity with small moral weight. Selective immediacy here is likewise not transparent valuation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The immediate as a shortcut that ends in expulsion.** Lexical evidence: `ع ج ل B008` (quick travel and shortcut path) in doubled `ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلْنَا`, `ص ل ي B003` (encountering fire and its heat) in `يَصْلَىٰهَا`, and `د ح ر B001` (driving away and distancing) in `مَّدْحُورًا`. Structural cue: 17:13–15 stages a full accounting process, 17:19 requires an end-matched striving, and 17:21 speaks of degrees. Assigned role: haste selects the abbreviated route; fire and expulsion specify its terminal encounter and loss of proximity. Abductive move: the packet contrasts immediate receipt with sustained striving; I infer that bypassing the latter produces a route that is short in acquisition but distancing in outcome. Reading change: desire for `العاجلة` reads as choosing a shortcut architecture, not simply preferring one object over another.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:19's matched striving and 17:21's degrees exposed the shortcut mechanism retrospectively: the immediate route bypasses both proper work and stepwise ascent.

baseline.text: Kim hemen elde edileni isterse orada dilediğimiz şeyi dilediğimiz kimse için çabucak veririz. Sonra ona Cehennemi veririz; kınanmış ve kovulmuş olarak oraya girer.

findings.text: Hemen elde edileni istemek, hızlanmayı sonuç üzerinde denetim sanır; oysa verilecek şeyin ve alacak kişinin ayrıca belirlenmesi bu denetim varsayımını bozar.
Hızlı yol, elde edişte mesafeyi kısaltırken sonunda ateşle karşılaşma ve uzaklaştırılma yüzünden hedefe yakınlığı kaybettiren bir kestirmeye dönüşür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 (17:1-22): Desire, Effort, and Apportioned Outcome
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An inward aim becomes motion and work, while the eventual share is extended, limited, or ranked by an allocator beyond the worker.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Desire appears as bodily haste and route choice, striving carries an emancipation sense, and allotment behaves like a connected supply distributed by degree.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Two Desired Horizons and Their Work
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Will selects a horizon, haste pursues the near one, while deliberate striving toward the later one joins motion, work, trust, and acknowledged yield.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: will and intention (`quranic:root_000610:B001/m01`); searching for a desired object (`quranic:root_000610:B003/m01`); accelerated advance (`quranic:root_000987:B001/m01`); purposive movement (`quranic:root_000709:B001/m01`); work and acquisition (`quranic:root_000709:B002/m01`); labor toward emancipation (`quranic:root_000709:B005/m01`); settled trust (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); acknowledged benefit (`quranic:root_000810:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The opposition is not simply between two objects. The near horizon solicits acceleration, whereas the later horizon requires fitted striving and work. The emancipation sense of `سعي` usefully pressures the reading: disciplined effort is a movement out of bondage to immediacy.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini çekirdek kabul eder ve buna olma adları ile geçmiş ya da şimdiki bildirme kullanımlarını bağlar. Pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oluşturma kullanımları aynı dal içinde bağımlı kullanımlar olarak durur; yer, konum ve üstlenme dalları bu çekirdeğin yerine geçirilmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerçekleşme ve bulunma çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; yer, konum, üstlenme ve boyun eğme ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam hem yalın hem bağlı kullanımlar verdiği için tanım çekirdeği ayrı, bağlı sözleri ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini ve bu olmanın geçmiş ya da şimdiki anda bildirilmesini anlatır. Olma adları, pekiştirme ya da ayırma işlevli bağlı sözler ve bir şeyi oldurup oluşmasını sağlama buna bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.
Olma ve oluş adları bu çekirdeğin adlaştırılmış biçimleridir.
Geçmişteki bir durumun haber verilmesi veya şimdiki olmanın bildirilmesi bu alana bağlıdır.
Pekiştirme ve gelen kişiyi kapsam dışı bırakma gibi bağlı söz dizimleri çekirdeğe ek kullanımlardır.
Bir şeyi oldurmak, onun gerçekleşmesini sağlama yönünde ettirgen bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, dalı bir şeyin olması, gerçekleşmesi ve hazır bulunması etrafında toplar. Aynı bildirim içinde olma adları, geçmiş ya da şimdiki haber verme, pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oldurma kullanımları da bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

Arama, yumusak ve yinelenen bir gidip gelme hareketiyle yurutulebilir.
Otlak bulmak icin giden veya onde gonderilen arayici kisiyi adlandirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanit, bir seyi arama, ararken bakip gidip gelme ve ozellikle otlak aramak uzere giden ya da gonderilen kisiyi adlandirma yonlerini birlestirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir seyi bulmak amaciyla cevreyi gozden gecirip gidip gelerek yurutulen arama eylemi icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Arama amacini, bakmayi ve hareket ederek cevreyi yoklamayi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aramanin hareket biciminden cok bulunmak istenen seyin one ciktigi genel baglamlarda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir seyi bulmaya yonelik arama amacini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yumusakca gidip gelme ve cevreyi adim adim gozden gecirme bicimini belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Topluluk veya suru icin otlak bulmak uzere onde giden ya da gonderilen kisiyi anlatan baglamlarda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kisinin arama gorevini, onde gitmesini ve otlak amacini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir seyi yumusakca dolasip gozden gecirerek aramak

error_profile.loses: Bulmak icin bakma, yer degistirme ve arama eylemlerinin tumunu siler.
error_profile.collision: Dileme ve yonelme dalinin cekirdegiyle karisir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, hareket ederek cevreyi gozden gecirmeyi ve otlak arayan oncu kisiyi ozellikle kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal, soyut ya da somut herhangi bir seyi bulmaya calismayi ve aramayi yinelemeyi daha genis bicimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir seyi bulmak icin arama ve bakma eylemini anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal arayisi gidip gelme ve cevreyi yoklama bicimiyle somutlastirir, ozellikle otlak arayicisini adlandirir; komsu dal ise aranan seyin turu ve hareket bicimi bakimindan daha genistir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yumusakca gidip gelerek bakmayi ve otlak arayicisini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal, aramayi eksiksiz ve derinlemesine surdurme kosulunu one cikarir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal, bir yerde gizli tehlike ya da dinlemesi uygun olmayan kimse bulunup bulunmadigini denetler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir alani dolasip bakarak bilinmeyen bir seyi ortaya cikarmaya calisir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, tek yone cikistan sonra gidip gelme ve yinelenen yer degistirme goruntusunu cekirdek olarak verir; surunun otlakta dolasmasi, komsu evlerine sik gidis ve yatakta durulamama bu cekirdegin acik gerceklesmeleridir. Hazirlanan dal bunlari arama veya yavaslik anlamindan dogru bicimde ayirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirleyici ozellik gidis gelisin yinelenmesidir; arama amaci, hiz ya da yumusaklik zorunlu degildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin gidip gelme cekirdegi, suru, yer, komsu ziyareti ve yatakta durulamama gibi yapilara bagli gerceklesmelerden ayri tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yone cikildiktan sonra geri donerek gidip gelmeyi veya yerler arasinda yinelenen bicimde dolasmayi anlatir. Bu hareket surunun otlakta ileri geri yayilmasinda, bir yere sik sik gidilmesinde, gidilip gelinen yerde ya da yatakta durulamamada gorulebilir.

facets.statement: Bir yere gidip geri gelerek yinelenen yer degistirme hareketidir.
Surunun otlakta one ve arkaya dogru dolasmasi bu hareketin bir gerceklesmesidir.
Gidilip gelinen yer, yinelenen hareketin gerceklestigi alan olarak adlandirilir.
Bir kadinin komsu evleri arasinda sikca dolasmasi bu goruntuyle anlatilir.
Yastikta bir turlu durulamayip donup durma, gidip gelme goruntusunun yataktaki karsiligidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanit, gidip gelme cekirdegini surunun otlakta ileri geri hareketi, gidilip gelinen yer, komsu evleri arasinda dolasma ve yastikta durulamama gibi somut gerceklesmelerle destekler.

error_profile.preserves: Hareketin gidis ve donuslu, yinelenen yapisini eksiksiz korur.

error_profile.preserves: Yinelenen gidis gelisi ve alan icindeki dolasma goruntusunu korur.

error_profile.preserves: Yerler arasindaki yinelenen gidis ve donusu acikca verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kisinin yastiginda veya yataginda bir turlu durulamadigi baglamlarda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Yerlesememe ve yinelenen hareket goruntusunu korur.

Yuruyus ve yol almada hiz kesip yumusak ilerlemeyi anlatir.
Birine yavaslamasini, acele etmemesini veya beklemesini soyleyen buyruk olarak kullanilir.
Sert ve guclu esmeyen yumusak ruzgar bu niteligin dogadaki ornegidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki kanitta da ayni goz soz dizisini ve gozde dolasan bir bozukluk anlamini verir. Hazirlanan dal bu anlami otlak arayan kisi ya da degirmen kolu gibi ayni bicimli adlardan ayirir ve yalnizca goz yapisina baglar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalniz gozle kurulan soz dizisinde gecerlidir; tek basina genel bir kusur veya kisi adi sayilamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalniz gozde dolasan bozuklugu adlandiran sabit soz dizisine baglidir ve bu anlam tek basina kullanilan bicime genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Gozun icinde dolasan veya yer degistirir gibi duyumsanan bir bozuklugu anlatan gozle sinirli bir adlandirmadir.

facets.statement: Gozde dolasan ya da yer degistirir gibi duyumsanan bozukluktur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanit, belirli goz soz dizisini gozun icinde dolasan bir bozukluk olarak ayni bicimde aciklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnizca kaynakta verilen goz soz dizisinin goz icindeki hareketli bozuklugu adlandirdigi kullanim icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bozuklugun goze bagli olmasini ve goz icinde dolasma niteligini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eski goz bozuklugu adinin okuyucuya aciklayici ve dogal bir Turkceyle aktarilmasi gereken baglamlarda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Gozdeki rahatsizlik ile onun dolasir gibi gorunen niteligini birlikte korur.
Gozde bir rahatsizlik veya bozukluk bulunmasini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bozuklugun gozde dolasmasi veya yer degistirir gibi olmasi niteligini siler.
error_profile.adds: Kaynagin belirtmedigi belirli bir iltihap tanisini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Goz yangisi dalindaki hastalikla karisir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal, gozun yangisini ve bu hastaliga tutulmus kisiyi anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: hareketli goz bozuklugu ile goz yangisi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da gozde ortaya cikan bir rahatsizlik veya bozukluk alanindadir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir bozuklugu gozde dolasma niteligine gore adlandirir; komsu dal ise goz yangisini ve buna bagli hastalik durumunu adlandirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal gozde dolasan genel bir bozukluk goruntusu verir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal, gozdeki nokta, kabarcik, damar ya da belirli bir hastalik belirtisini somutlastirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal da goz icinde algilanan yerel bir bozuklugu adlandirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalin ayirici ozelligi dolasma veya yer degistirme goruntusudur; komsu dal ise nokta, kabarcik ya da damar gibi belirli bir goz bulgusunu adlandirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bozuklugun goz icinde dolasir gibi olmasini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal goze dusen bir copun yol actigi agirlik duyumunu bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal goze ozgu bir rahatsizlik duyumunu anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hareketli bir bozukluk goruntusune dayanir; komsu dal ise disaridan gelen bir copun gozde olusturdugu agirlikla sinirlidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnizca gozde dolasan belirli bir bozuklugu adlandirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal herhangi bir seyin kusurunu, eksigini veya kusurlu sayilmasini genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ozel goz bozuklugu ile genel kusur
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir bedende veya nesnede bulunan kusur ve eksiklik alanini paylasir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal organ ve hareket niteligince son derece sinirlidir; komsu dal ise goz veya hareket sarti olmadan her tur kusur ve eksige uzanir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, genc kiz ile genc ve guzel kadin adlandirmalarini acikca destekler. Bununla birlikte kucultmeli bir bicimin buyutulmus karsiligi olduguna iliskin not, tek basina genclik anlamini kurmaz; bu nedenle dal korunur ancak bu bicimsel bag anlam taniminin disinda tutulur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kadin icin genc, kimi bicimlerde de genc ve guzel olma nitelemesiyle sinirlidir; bicimsel buyutme notu ayri bir genclik anlami sayilmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genc kiz nitelemesi belirli bir ad soz dizisinde, genc ve guzel kadin anlami ise ayri bir ad biciminde gerceklesir; biri digerinin sinirlarini genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kiz veya kadini genc diye niteleyen adlandirmadir. Ayri sesletisli ad bicimleri, genclige guzellik niteligini da ekleyerek genc ve guzel kadini anlatir.

facets.statement: Kiz veya kadin icin genc olma niteligini bildirir.
Belirli ad bicimlerinde genclik ile guzellik birlikte belirtilir.
Kucultmeli bir bicimin buyutulmus karsiligina iliskin aciklama bicimsel bagdir ve genclik tanimina yeni bir ozellik eklemez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanit, bir ad soz dizisinde genc kizi ve ayri sesletisli bicimlerde genc ve guzel kadini belirtir; ayrica anlam sinirini genisletmeyen bir bicim buyutme bagi kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: genc kiz veya genc ve guzel kadin
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalin genc kiz cekirdegini ve ayri ad bicimlerindeki genc ve guzel kadin ozellesmesini birlikte gosteren baslik olarak uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kadin cinsiyetini, gencligi ve belirli bicimde eklenen guzellik niteligini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadin kisinin yalnizca genc oldugunun belirtildigi ad soz dizisinde kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kadin cinsiyetini ve genc yas niteligini dogrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ayri sesletisli ad bicimlerinin genclik ile guzelligi birlikte bildirdigi baglamlarda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kadin olma, genclik ve guzellik niteliklerinin tumunu korur.

error_profile.loses: Butun dalda kurucu olan genc yas niteligini belirtmez.
error_profile.collision: Yas siniri bulunmayan genel guzellik nitelemesiyle karisir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal, kadin kisiyi veya onun cocukluk ve ilk genclik donemini daha genel adlandirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kadin cinsiyetine baglidir ve kimi bicimlerde guzelligi de bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal, erkek genci ve yeni, taze ya da baslangic durumundaki cansiz seyleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal da insanin genc ve yasca yeni olmasini anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalniz kiz veya kadini niteler; komsu dal ise cinsiyet sinirini asar ve genclik dusuncesini nesnelerin yeniligi ile yakin zamana da yayar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalniz kadin kisiyi niteler ve bir alt bicimde guzelligi ekler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal hem genc erkegi hem genc kizi adlandirabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genc kadin ile her iki cinsten genc
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal genc kiz veya genc kadin anlaminda ortusebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kadin cinsiyetine bagli ve kimi bicimlerde guzellik iceren bir nitelemedir; komsu dal ise genc insan adini erkek ve kadin icin kullanir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal gencligi zorunlu tutar ve guzelligi yalniz belirli bicimlerde ekler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal, kadinin dolgun ve guzel olmasini anlatir ancak genc olmasini gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genc ve guzel kadin ile dolgun guzel kadin
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kadini olumlu bir gorunus niteligiyla adlandirabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalin temel siniri genc yastir; komsu dalda ise belirleyici nitelikler dolgunluk ve guzelliktir, yas siniri kaynak kartinda kurulmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi hem bir şeyin ya da kişinin önceki yerine veya durumuna dönmesini hem de onun oraya döndürülmesini açıkça ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Görmenin yeniden kazanılması bu çekirdeğin bir durumun geri gelmesi biçimindeki özel gerçekleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek dönüş ve geri döndürmedir; yalnızca engelleme, reddetme, ticari geri alma veya yineleme bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dönüş çekirdeğini korur; yön bildiren, yetki devreden ve belirli bir durumun geri gelmesini anlatan yapılar ayrı özel kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin veya kişinin önceki yerine, sahibine ya da durumuna dönmesi yahut bir etken tarafından oraya döndürülmesidir. Kaybolmuş bir işlevin yeniden kazanılması da aynı geri gelme düzeninin özel bir görünümüdür.

facets.statement: Hareketin temel yönü, bir varlığın daha önce bulunduğu yere veya duruma geri gelmesidir.
Geçişli kullanımda bir etken, şeyi yerine, sahibine veya bağlı olduğu merciye geri gönderir.
Bir yetinin yeniden ortaya çıkması, önceki durumun geri kazanılması olarak kavranır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortaklaştırılmış anlatımı, kendiliğinden geri gelme ile bir şeyi geri gönderme biçimlerini tek dönüş çekirdeğinde birleştirir; yer, sahip, merci ve önceki işlev bu yönün farklı hedefleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir varlığın önceki yerine, sahibine ya da durumuna yöneldiği hem geçişsiz hem geçişli kullanımlar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dönüş yönünü, önceki konumu veya durumu ve ettirgen geri gönderme seçeneğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Görme gibi kaybolmuş bir işlevin yeniden kazanıldığı bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki durumun veya işlevin yeniden elde edilmesini açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin sahibine veya ait olduğu yere gönderildiği geçişli bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Nesneyi ait olduğu kişiye veya yere geri yöneltme ilişkisini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi yöneldiği taraftan çevirmeyi ve zarar, lütuf ya da ceza bağlamında onu savuşturup engellemeyi aynı uzaklaştırma işlevinde birleştirir. Sunulan dal çerçevesi bu yapıya bağlı anlamı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir şeyi bir yönden veya hedeften uzaklaştıran yapılara bağlıdır; yalın geri dönüş ve kabul etmeme ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca yön, hedef veya engelleme ilişkisini açıkça kuran yapılarda geçerlidir; yalın köke genel bir engelleme anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi yöneldiği yol, hedef veya eylemden çevirerek uzaklaştırmak; böylece bir etkiyi, zararı ya da sonucu savuşturmak veya engellemektir.

Bir etki ya da sonucun gerçekleşmesine engel olmak, onu hedeften uzaklaştırmanın özel biçimidir.
Çevirme sert bir savma biçiminde olabileceği gibi bir işten yumuşakça vazgeçirme biçiminde de gerçekleşebilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi kabul etmeme, sözü yanlış sayma ve sahte olduğu anlaşılan parayı geri çevirme kullanımlarını açıkça bir araya getirir. Dal çerçevesi, geri göndermeyi tek başına değil olumsuz değerlendirme sonucuna bağlı olarak sunar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirleyici unsur kabul etmeme veya geçersiz saymadır; yalnızca geri gönderme ya da zarar savuşturma yeterli değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, bir şeyi kişiye karşı geri çeviren veya sahte parayı geri veren yapılara bağlıdır; yalın kök için genel reddetme anlamı kurulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sunulan bir şeyi kabul etmeyip sahibine geri çevirmek veya bir söz ya da iddiayı yanlış ve geçersiz saymaktır. Daha önce alınmış sahte paranın denetleyene geri verilmesi bu değerlendirmenin somut ticari örneğidir.

facets.statement: Nesne, söz veya iddia olumsuz değerlendirme sonucunda kabul edilmez.
Bir sözü yanlış saymak, kabul etmemenin doğruluk değerlendirmesine uygulanmış biçimidir.
Sahte olduğu belirlenen paranın onu denetleyene geri verilmesi, kabul etmemenin ticari örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortaklaştırılmış ifade, reddetme eylemini kabul ve doğruluk değerlendirmesine bağlar; sahte paranın geri çevrilmesi bu çekirdeğin nesnel bir denetim sonucunda gerçekleşen örneğidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi bir malın geri verilmesini istemeyi veya onu geri almayı, ayrıca bozulan satışta iki tarafın aldıklarını karşılıklı vermesini açıkça kapsar. Dalın ticari ve karşılıklı sınırı kanıtla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, geri isteme ve satışın bozulmasında karşılıklı iade ile sınırlıdır; sıradan dönüş veya yeni bir satış işlemi değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Genel dönüş dalı din veya inkâr koşulu taşımaz; bu dal yalnızca açık dinî geçişte kullanılabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel din değişimi, bağ çözme ve genel dönüşle sınırı en iyi gösteren üç komşu seçildi.

branches.source_phrase_ar: سمي المرتد لأنه رد نفسه إلى كفره (maqayis)؛ الارتداد الرجوع ومنه المرتد والردة الاسم من الارتداد (sihah)؛ ارتد الرجل عن دينه ردة إذا كفر بعد إسلامه (tahdhib)؛ الردة تختص بالكفر والارتداد يستعمل فيه وفي غيره (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi boşanmış ve ailesine geri gönderilmiş kadını temel adlandırma olarak verir; kızın yeniden babasının geçimine bağımlı olması da bu durumun açıklayıcı örneğidir. Sunulan dal çerçevesi bu katılımcı ve durum sınırını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu ad yalnızca boşanıp ailesine geri gönderilen kadını belirtir; her boşanmış kişi veya ailesine dönen her kadın kapsamda değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kanıtta ad olarak verilen boşanmış ve ailesine dönmüş kadın anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yapı bağımlı başka bir okuma eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Boşandıktan sonra ailesine, özellikle baba evine geri gönderilen kadındır. Başka geçim sağlayanı bulunmayan kızın yeniden babasının bakımına girmesi bunun açıklayıcı bir örneğidir.

facets.statement: Kadın boşanmış ve eşinin yanından ailesine geri gönderilmiştir.
Ailesine dönüş, geçimini sağlayan başka bir kimse olmadığında yeniden baba bakımına girme sonucunu doğurabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım adlandırmayı boşanmış kadının ailesine geri gönderilmesine bağlar; yeniden babanın geçimine bağlı kalan kız örneği bu toplumsal ve ekonomik sonucu açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Boşanma sonrasında ailesine geri gönderilen kadın için kullanılır; geçim bağımlılığı yalnızca açıklayıcı örnek bağlamında eşlik edebilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kadını, boşanmayı ve aileye geri gönderilmeyi korur; geçim bağımlılığını zorunlu koşul yapmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Özellikle kızın boşanma sonrası babasının evine ve bakımına döndüğü aile bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Boşanma sonrasında baba evine ve aile bakımına geri dönme durumunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: boşanmış ve ailesine geri dönmüş kadın

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal boşanma sonrasında aileye geri gönderilmeyi ve yeniden geçim bağımlılığını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kocasından dönmüş, daha önce evlenmiş kadını daha kısa ve daha genel bir durum adıyla belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal evlilik bağından çıkıp önceki aile hayatına dönen kadını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda boşanma, aileye gönderilme ve geçim bağımlılığı birlikte belirgindir; komşu kart bunların tümünü zorunlu kılmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kadının dönüşü boşanma sonrasında ve ailesinin bakımına yeniden girme biçimindedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kadının boşanmadan önce veya izin almadan eşinin evinden ailesine çıkmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: boşanma sonrası dönüş ile evden çıkış
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da kadın eşinin evinden ayrılarak kendi ailesine gider.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hukuki ve toplumsal olarak boşanma sonrasındaki geri gönderilmeyi adlandırır; komşu dal boşanma gerçekleşmeden de olabilen ayrılma eylemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yalnızca boşanmış ve ailesine geri gönderilmiş kadına yönelir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal eşi olmayan kadın veya erkeği, evlenmeden kalmayı ve eşsiz bırakılmayı genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: aileye dönen boşanmış kadın ile eşsiz kişi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Boşanmış kadının eşsiz kalması iki alanın kesiştiği durumdur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Eşsiz olma tek başına odak dal için yeterli değildir; aileye geri gönderilme tek başına da komşu dalın geniş eşsizlik alanını karşılamaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı karşılaştırıldı; boşanma, aileye dönüş ve eşsiz kalma sınırlarını en açık gösteren üç komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المردودة من النساء، وهي المطلقة الراجعة إلى أهلها أو أبيها ولا كاسب لها
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مطلق الرجوع ولا كل امرأة إلا إذا كانت مطلقة مردودة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: المردودة المرأة المطلقة وابنتك مردودة عليك ليس لها كاسب غيرك (maqayis)؛ المردودة المطلقة (sihah)؛ المردودة من النساء المطلقة وابنتك مردودة عليك لا كاسب لها غيرك (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi hayvan memesinin sütle dolması ile ırmak veya denizde su ya da dalga bolluğunu açıkça aynı dalda toplar. Uzun süre eşsiz kalan erkek kullanımı ise doğrudan genel su birikimi değil, yoğun cinsel istek ve bedensel sıvı birikimiyle açıklanan ayrı bir özel kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sıvı doluluğu ve bolluğu eksenindedir; erkekle ilgili kullanım bu eksenin özel bedensel uzantısı olarak ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hayvan, su kütlesi ve erkek bildiren bağlı kullanımlar ayrıştırılır; bunların özellikleri yalın kökün genel anlamıymış gibi birleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Sütün bir hayvanın memesinde dolması veya suyun bir ırmak ya da denizde çok ve dalgalı olmasıdır. Uzun süre eşsiz kalan erkeğin bedensel sıvı birikimiyle yoğun istek duyması bunun özel ve kişiye bağlı uzantısıdır.

facets.statement: Bir yerde sıvı doluluğu veya belirgin sıvı bolluğu oluşur.
Doğumdan önce hayvan memesinin sütle dolması, çekirdeğin hayvancılığa özgü gerçekleşmesidir.
Irmakta suyun veya denizde su ve dalganın çokluğu, doluluk çekirdeğinin doğal çevreye uzanmasıdır.
Uzun süre eşsiz kalan erkekte birikim ve yoğun cinsel istek birlikte anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım sütle dolu meme ile bol sulu veya çok dalgalı su kütlesini doluluk ekseninde birleştirir; uzun eşsizlik sonucu yoğun istek duyan erkek bu sıvı birikimi tasarımına bağlı özel kullanımdır.

concept_gloss.text: sütün, suyun veya bedensel sıvının birikip çoğalması
concept_gloss.applicability: Hayvan memesindeki süt doluluğu, su kütlesindeki bolluk ve erkeğe bağlı özel birikim kullanımlarını birlikte kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Sıvı birikimini, miktar artışını ve hayvan, çevre ile insan bağlamlarındaki ayrımı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Koyun veya devenin doğum öncesinde memesinin sütle dolduğu hayvancılık bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan memesindeki süt doluluğunu ve doğum öncesi durumu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Irmak ya da denizin çok su veya çok dalga taşıdığı doğal çevre bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Su kütlesindeki miktar ve dalga bolluğunu açıkça korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: memesine süt inmiş veya memesi sütle dolmuş deve
